10k.note: TransMedics is a medical device / organ-transplant logistics company; the 10-K describes the OCS device platform and National OCS Program, not drug assets.

website.note: Public site presents OCS Heart, OCS Lung, OCS Liver and the National OCS Program; no drug pipeline page.

ctgov.note: 0 sponsored P1-P3 interventional drug trials with TransMedics as sponsor.

commercial_product.summary: TransMedics develops and commercializes the Organ Care System (OCS), a portable warm-perfusion platform that preserves donor organs in a near-physiologic state for transplantation, plus the National OCS Program (NOP) logistics service.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medtech / device company — no proprietary clinical drug pipeline. TransMedics commercializes the FDA-approved OCS organ-preservation device platform and runs a logistics service (NOP); it does not own IND-stage drug assets and has no active P1/P2/P3 drug trials.
